scope: Add timestamped source archive, SQLite product requirements/features/oracles and bounded OCaml catalog tooling using existing UOS elements; targeted local implementation/verification only; no production cutover or imported executable source.

snapshot.reference: Stable source specification and execution policy digests at UOS parent 1c6afaae; implementation artifacts bound separately after changes.

criticality.rationale: Explicit user request for complete product requirement coverage and usable catalog.

stpa.rationale: Catalog truth can influence later actions; production effects remain gated.

fmea.rationale: S4 O3 Det3 RPN36: credible false coverage or destructive data import; transaction and honest evidence status prevent propagation.

dependency.rationale: Requirement and oracle register feeds native implementation and acceptance.

impact.rationale: All 21 requested service categories benefit from traceable specification.

fmea_modes.cause: Unverified mappings or stale claims promoted to complete; nontransactional import.
fmea_modes.effect: Incorrect production admission decisions or damaged specification rows.
fmea_modes.controls: Namespaced additive schema, parameterized transaction, readback, input hashes, explicit UNRUN and NOT_ADMITTED states.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Import blueprint and bind native service implementation evidence

ucas.context: Required service or security constraint omitted from specification.
ucas.constraint: Verify all 21 taxonomy services, six readiness criteria and detailed acceptance coverage.

ucas.context: Source presence reported as verified behavior or arbitrary SQL overwrites existing catalog.
ucas.constraint: Use conservative states and additive transaction with bound parameters.

ucas.context: Evidence belongs to an old candidate or import runs without current claim.
ucas.constraint: Recheck hashes, preflight and active ownership before effects.

ucas.context: Catalog process exceeds lease or imports incomplete state after cancellation.
ucas.constraint: Bound process and transactions; rollback failures and stop on lease expiry.

decision.summary: Complete the authorized native product catalog, revalidate available oracles, and implement/test bounded native functionality based on observed gaps.
counterevidence: The prior map records incomplete production controls; source presence cannot establish parity.
assumptions: User requests native UOS reuse; third-party sources are read-only behavior references.
decision.forecast: All original service requirements become queryable with explicit gaps and reproducible acceptance links.
decision.falsifier: A missing service, duplicated row, changed source digest or unexecuted test appears as verified.
acceptance: SQLite integrity, idempotence and non-destructive additive import verified
Native targeted tests produce actual scoped results
decision.rollback: Rollback failed SQLite transactions; retain pre-import local backup; revert only this task's JJ file changes after review.
decision.reviewer: Author tests and source review; independent admission NOT_ADMITTED.
decision.budget: Single agent, sequential native writes, one compilation job, bounded local tests, zero paid oracle/model requests; no production deployment.
residuals: Full production service admission requires actual security, isolation and runtime evidence for each gap.
